route45.expression: dx = end.x - start.x; dy = end.y - start.y; Math.abs(dx); Math.abs(dy); Math.min(abs(dx), abs(dy)); start.x + Math.sign(dx) * diagonal

rotatePoint.expression: radians = degrees * Math.PI / 180; cos = Math.cos(radians); sin = Math.sin(radians); x = point.x * cos - point.y * sin; y = point.x * sin + point.y * cos

transformLocalPoint.expression: rotated = rotatePoint(local, rotation); x = origin.x + rotated.x; y = origin.y + rotated.y

expressions.degree_radian_order: degrees * Math.PI / 180 (left associative: multiplication then division)
